protocol.policy: greedy (argmax logits), as in the probe rollouts
protocol.gate: final greedy reward >= 95% of the belief-grid reference
protocol.rollout_key: fold_in(PRNGKey(42), 3), shared across arms (common random numbers)
protocol.checkpoint_rewards: checkpoints screened with 84-episode probe-stream rewards; those >= 80% of reference re-evaluated with 1024 fresh episodes (same key)
protocol.gated_peak: max fixed-history full-h R² over gate-passing sampled checkpoints; exploratory (selected after inspection)
